findings.issue: Strict immutable schemas, types, bounds and observer result are not literally defined; independent tests cannot freeze the same interface.
findings.resolution: Add exact claim/connected/terminal/result key sets, nested identity equality, number units/ranges including bool/NaN refusal, nullable records, state/error precedence, and directory/file metadata admission. Define atomic no-replace publication through verified directory handles.

findings.issue: Exact ESTABLISHED fd/inode verification usually reads a namespace-wide /proc/<pid>/net/tcp table, conflicting with the unrelated-sockets prohibition and lacking a bounded parse.
findings.resolution: Permit only a capped IPv4 table read filtered to claimed inode and recorded endpoints; expose no unrelated rows, send no netlink/RPC probes. For example cap at1MiB and4096 rows, UNKNOWN on overflow/unavailable. Pin directory/file handles with no-follow reads; bracket PID start/state, claimed fd link and path device/inode checks so replacement/reuse cannot silently rebind the ticket. No broad fd scan.

findings.issue: Overall deadline is stated but late recv return/END precedence is not explicit, and metadata failure ordering must preserve already received payload before generator failure.
findings.resolution: For opt-in only, specify post-recv monotonic budget check and TIMEOUT at/after deadline even with END; retain actual bounded payload prefix. Receipt close/terminal bookkeeping may follow expiry without extending receive eligibility. Final retrieval failure is recorded then raised only after available complete base64 fragments have been yielded/persisted; never replace an earlier receive/parser failure or publish a valid END after failed transport. Keep legacy no-ticket path unchanged.

need_minimality: Two modes suffice for sampled TCP connection evidence with existing blocking board.remote. A printed marker cannot be observed early through subprocess.run. No reservation lifecycle or streaming/background transport framework is necessary. This does not close exact router registration or UART framing prerequisites.
verified: Pinned monitor source accepts then inserts the connection; connect completion does not acknowledge insertion.
mon/connected is only len(sockets)>0 and cannot distinguish the existing socat client.
All four Monitor methods are unsuitable as a new exact receiver registration acknowledgement; no RPC is needed here.
Receive-only socket plus immutable Linux receipts adds no intentional MCU payload/reset/service action.
Fresh UUID remains caller obligation; current boot/PID/fd evidence is sampled, not an atomic lease or authenticated MCU identity.
limits: Draft/API/source preflight only, reused same-model reviewer. No implementation/tests executed; no board, socket, process control, upload, service or ledger changes. Cached source/package relationship is not a reproducible binary proof.
